Why you think you should be unbanned
I only threat because I couldn't use my will power to stop me from playing Minecraft, so I wanted to force myself. It was a stupid way and I regret it, I should have just made my brother put a password on my account so I wouldn't use it. I appealed a while back in February I think and it got denied because I was banned in January so it was too soon. They told me to reappeal in April but I decided to wait longer so then I will really show I regret it and that I have learned my lesson. I am sorry for making a threat and  I fully regret it. I just want to play with my brother and my old friends because some of my friends don't really play 1.7 or PotPvP in general so it is hard to stay in touch with them. I am sincerely sorry and hope you guys can forgive me.

-Shade/Kodae
